author: Rachel Green
title: Apple Pay pushes into e-commerce (AAPL)
text:

Apple Pay is partnering with Volusion, an e-commerce platform for small businesses, to create a “Buy Now” button for its merchants, according to PYMNTS .
Through the partnership, merchants can embed an Apple Pay "Buy Now" button into their product description pages, directing customers to the checkout page to purchase their goods using the mobile wallet. Integrating Apple Pay will eliminate the need for customers buying on these sites to enter their payment, shipping, and contact information every time they make an online purchase. For context, Volusion builds e-commerce websites for over 40,000 US-based small businesses and accepts orders from customers globally.
Streamlining the online checkout process could ultimately boost Apple Pay usage.
Apple Pay hasn't taken off strongly for in-store payments. Apple Pay's US adoption has been underwhelming — stagnating at around 25% of eligible users — due in part to the slow adoption of contactless payments, which comprised only 2% of US transactions last year, according to a Juniper study. That's making it necessary for it to find more effective ways to onboard new customers. Online purchases present a strong use case for the mobile wallet. Sixty-eight percent of all online shopping carts are abandoned before purchase, making cart abandonment a massive problem for retailers, which lose an estimated $4.6 trillion to abandoned carts on an annual basis. Small screens and slow connections on mobile devices in particular make shopping a challenge, and lead to conversion rates as low as 1.19% , according to Monetate. Apple Pay already helps solve these problems by leveraging preloaded payment data, and the new "Buy Now" feature, which uses stored shipping information as well, could take that a step further. That could help attract and onboard customers, growing adoption and potentially encouraging habit formation.
